SELECT
  store
  , CAST(net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(valid_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(refund_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(payment_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(cancelled_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(refund_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(discount_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(gross_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
  , CAST(valid_order_items AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    store
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      store_id AS store
      , 1 AS __order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __paid_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __cancelled_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __refund_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END AS __gross_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __discount_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END AS __buyer_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_items
    FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
  ) subq_16
  GROUP BY
    store
) subq_18
answer: 统计范围为当前客户青禾在2026年7月1日至2026年8月1日（2026年7月整月）的合成测试数据，按订单成交门店分组，未额外设置门店筛选。金额已由分换算为元并保留两位，比例按百分数展示。各成交门店结果：S02：有效订单均额50.00元/单，购买会员人均消费50.00元/账户，购买频次1.00单/账户，退款金额占比4.76%，取消率0.00%，退款订单率50.00%，优惠率0.00%，单均商品件数2.00件；S01：有效订单均额15.63元/单，购买会员人均消费15.63元/账户，购买频次1.00单/账户，退款金额占比0.00%，取消率11.11%，退款订单率0.00%，优惠率0.00%，单均商品件数1.125件；S03：有效订单均额45.00元/单，购买会员人均消费90.00元/账户，购买频次2.00单/账户，退款金额占比10.00%，取消率0.00%，退款订单率50.00%，优惠率0.00%，单均商品件数2.00件。口径说明：有效订单均额按净销售额/有效订单数，购买会员人均消费按净销售额/购买会员账户数，购买频次按有效订单数/购买会员账户数，退款金额占比按退款金额/实付金额，取消率按取消订单数/创建订单数，退款订单率按退款订单数/支付订单数，优惠率按优惠金额/支付订单原价金额，单均商品件数按有效订单商品件数/有效订单数。限制说明：人数按CRM会员账户计数，不等同于跨系统自然人已去重；表中的0.00%均为覆盖范围内实际计算为零，不是未定义。
